passed_checks: The root total_file_count and collection file_count both match the ten enumerated resources.
The current DOI agrees across identification, citation, version access and file collection metadata.
The root and collection licenses agree with the detailed noncommercial and share-alike terms.
The NIH Bridge2AI funding description and keywords align with the stated functional-genomics and biomedical-AI purposes.
Public file access is compatible with the explicitly restrictive reuse license.
The non-human-subject declaration and tissue-culture deidentification rationale are internally compatible.
warning_checks: The deidentification assertion lacks accompanying dedicated privacy safeguards and a documented risk assessment.
Included perturb-seq descriptions, public archive listings and external embargo statements leave actual payload availability unclear.
Source publication-date disagreement and later image-file issue dates require temporal interpretation beyond the initial release date.

correctness_validations.doi_format: Syntactically valid: 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C has a plausible DOI prefix and suffix and is consistently associated with the stated University of Virginia Dataverse repository. Resolution and registration were not externally checked.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: Plausible NIH award formats: 1OT2OD032742-01, 3OT2OD032742-01S2 and 5U54HG012513-02. Award existence was not externally checked.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: Outside the registered SCR_/AB_ patterns: RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 are presented as cell-line identifiers. The pattern mismatch is noted without asserting an intrinsic identifier error.
correctness_validations.url_validity: Supplied HTTP(S) URLs have plausible structure and domains. Several external data entries explicitly lack target URLs. No browsing, resolution or live availability checks were performed.

issues_detected.description: Four of the fourteen root fields named by Q1 are absent: resources, parent_datasets, variables and confidentiality classification. Nested archive entries do not populate root resources.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document variable metadata, applicable root-level relationships and confidentiality classification while preserving the distinction between archive listings and dataset resources.

issues_detected.description: Only ZIP/application/zip is documented as a file format, despite the four measurement modalities and ten-file enumeration.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify the actual formats and media types of payloads inside each archive. Do not infer format diversity from modality names.

issues_detected.description: Ethics entries identify contacts without a review process or outcome. The deidentification rationale is not accompanied by documented privacy safeguards or a substantive risk assessment.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the oversight determination and privacy assessment appropriate to these cell-line data, including the basis and limits of the claim that data cannot be linked to a human subject.

issues_detected.description: License, IP restrictions and a governance contact are supplied, but confidentiality classification and applicable regulatory obligations are not comprehensively documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the confidentiality classification and applicable compliance determinations, including documented reasons where a framework does not apply.

issues_detected.description: Historical RO-Crate packaging and MuSIC integration descriptions do not establish current-release schema conformance or actionable integration procedures.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify the schema versions and standards used by the current files, their validation status, common identifiers and procedures for integrating modalities.

issues_detected.description: FAIRSCAPE packaging is described with a URL but without a software version or comprehensive processing workflows for the measurement modalities.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document modality-specific transformations, quality-control steps, relevant software versions and workflow inputs and outputs, including explicit treatment of missing data where relevant.

issues_detected.description: Collection mechanisms and two laboratories are described, but collection timeframes and complete release-specific collector and protocol mappings are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add collection periods and connect each released data stream to its responsible laboratory, source material and applicable acquisition protocol.

issues_detected.description: Donor origins and experimental states are described, but population-selection rationale and inclusion/exclusion boundaries are insufficient for the comprehensive representation anchor.
issues_detected.recommendation: Explain why the selected cell lines and states were included, the relevant selection boundaries, and how their donor origins limit representation for the intended uses.

issues_detected.description: The Dataverse acquisition route is documented, but release-specific authorization requirements remain unclear. Public ZIP entries coexist with embargo statements for perturb-seq data and incomplete external target URLs.
issues_detected.recommendation: State authentication, registration, agreement and approval requirements for each access route; distinguish downloadable archive metadata from available data payloads and specify how embargoed streams can be obtained.

issues_detected.description: Explicit licensing and research-use guidance are present, but comprehensive social-impact analysis and risk mitigation are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Analyze foreseeable beneficial and harmful downstream uses, identify affected groups and document concrete mitigations and discouraged applications.

issues_detected.description: Release history, laboratory attribution, packaging descriptions and checksums do not establish complete entity-activity-agent relationships and derivation paths for the released data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Supply textual or machine-readable lineage connecting source entities, processing activities, responsible agents and resulting files, with identifiers for inputs and outputs.

issues_detected.description: Representational limitations are identified without standardized bias categorization, fairness analysis or systematic assessment of downstream effects.
issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize documented biases using an appropriate standard taxonomy and assess their effects on model generalization, subgroup performance and suitable mitigation strategies.

issues_detected.description: The record explicitly reports conflicting source publication years and prefers the Dataverse date. Image archives have July 2026 issue dates after the June 2026 dataset publication, which could reflect later additions but are not mapped to a specific version event.
issues_detected.recommendation: Preserve the disclosed source disagreement and connect later file issue dates to the relevant repository version or update event.

issues_detected.description: RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 fall outside the registered instrument's stated SCR_/AB_ patterns. They are presented as cell-line identifiers; this pattern mismatch does not itself demonstrate that the identifiers are wrong and does not invalidate the independently sufficient dataset DOI.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the identifiers and distinguish the instrument's narrow RRID pattern check from a substantive determination of cell-line identifier correctness.

semantic_insights: The complete unwrapped root datasheet is the sole scoring unit. Nested file records contribute evidence at their actual locations without becoming separate units or filling absent root fields.
The record clearly distinguishes project-level goals and statistics from the June 2026 release, including the absence of computed cell maps.
Source disagreements are disclosed rather than silently resolved into unsupported certainty, and historical descriptions are explicitly separated from current-release assertions.
Funding and creator attribution, formal citation, version history and institutionally supported preservation are strong.
The declared nonclinical tissue-culture setting is compatible with human-derived cell lines; a false human-subject flag is not inherently inconsistent with donor-origin metadata.
No conditional item is excluded because the independently supplied applicability context is empty.
